text:
maya: Heads up — planning to unpin runtime v3.4 on canary at 2026-03-23T22:00PT. Any blockers? @deploybot can you schedule? :eyes:

deploybot: Scheduled unpin of runtime v3.4 for canary on 2026-03-23T22:00PT (requested by maya). Current pinlist snapshot:
```
- model_group: longseq
  pinned_runtime: v3.3
  reason: longseq OOM regression
```

simon: can we exempt embed-heavy / longseq workloads? longseq telemetry still shows kvcache mismatch on canary.

liz: +1 exempt longseq. production embedding traffic is small but sensitive to regressions.

maya: proposal: do a soft-unpin for general models, keep a sticky pin for longseq for 12h, run telemetry & smoke tests post-unpin, then reassess. Rollback criteria: if error rate > 1.5% or latency P95 regresses > 30% -> immediate rollback.

eng-oncall: noted. I'll be on watch and will escalate if thresholds breach.

simon: please add the command we will run to the thread so ops can copy/paste: 
```
deploybot unpin --runtime v3.4 --scope canary --exclude-group longseq --note "soft-unpin canary; longseq sticky-pin 12h"
```

deploybot: Confirmed. Scheduled job created (id: jb-20260323-22-01). Will post preflight status to this thread.

maya: Quick QA checklist before execution: 1) smoke-gen on canary 2) longseq evict test 3) token-level latency diff. Add items?

liz: Add: verify embedding accuracy on 50 sample queries (run eval job `eval/embed-compare:v1`).

simon: and validate rollback works in dry-run: `deploybot rollback --to v3.3 --scope canary --dry-run`.

deploybot: Preflight at T-20m: smoke tests PASSED (latency P95 within 12% of baseline). longseq evict test FAILED — OOM observed on node canary-12.

maya: Hold. Do not unpin. Thanks for the preflight. We'll keep v3.4 pinned for longseq until we root cause.

liz: Can we do a targeted warmup or tune kvcache on canary-12 temporarily to mitigate?

simon: I can repro locally. Looks like a KV cache pointer arithmetic regression in v3.4 when seq > 16k. I'll open a patch PR but won't land before the window.

maya: Revised plan: unpin for everything except longseq (keep sticky pin for longseq until fix merged + canary validated). Delay general unpin by +2h. Update release notes and ops playbook.

deploybot: Updated schedule: unpin runtime v3.4 for canary excluding longseq at 3498772800. Pinlist annotation appended:
```
- model_group: longseq
  pinned_runtime: v3.4
  hold_until: manual
  reason: KV cache OOM on seq>16k
```

eng-oncall: Monitoring plan: I'll watch error rate and latency dashboards. Escalation path: if traffic errors > 1% or P95 > baseline +30% I'll page eng-sre and post to #incidents.

maya: Thanks. I'll tag @here in ops at T-30m before execution and post the final go/no-go. I'll also update the PR for release notes with the sticky-pin rationale.

simon: Working PR #1123 (pointer fix + regression test). ETA ~6h. If merged we can lift sticky pin after canary run.

liz: I'll prepare the release note entry and the rollback snippet for docs.

deploybot: Thread update (automated): schedule updated and preflight results posted. Will post again at execution and after verification.

maya: Appreciate the quick loop. Will reconvene if preflight changes. Rolling to ops for final go/no-go later.
